title: Woo Ta Tseu

page_data.en:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Shanghai Municipal Council.
（批：G. I. D. ... No. 6884 ... 3/11/16）

November 1st 1916

Sir,
It is reported that a telegram was received by General Yang on the 31st ult from Woo Ta Tseu 吴大洲 and Poo Ts Ming 薄子明 revolutionary leaders in Shantung. They invited General Yang to participate in sending a joint telegram to the Central Government on the subject of the Tientsin incident. As General Yang does not know the above two men he telegraphed a refusal.
General Yang sent a staff officer to Nanking on the 31st ult to convey his congratulations to Tuchun Feng on his appointment to the Vice Presidency.
About 350 rebels, natives of Anwhui have left Shanghai for Hankow where they will place themselves under the leadership of one Shang Hai Zee 向海潜. The ultimate intentions of the party are not known.
At a meeting of ex-Chinese Volunteers in the City on the 31st ult it was decided to hold a celebration on the occasion of the proposed re-organization of the force on the 3rd inst. At the same time and place (Sing Woo Dan theatre) a memorial service will be held for members killed during the revolution.
It is reported that the noted rebel leader General Huang Hsin died at his residence No.393 Route Ferguson at 4 a.m. on the 31st ult. He had been suffering from elust and stomach trouble for some time. It is announced that the preliminary ceremonies in connection with his funeral will be held to-day at 8 p.m.

（批：D/S）

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

上海工部局。
（批：G. I. D. ... 第6884号 ... 1916年11月3日）

1916年11月1日

先生：

据报，杨将军于上月31日收到来自山东的革命领袖吴大洲和薄子明的电报。他们邀请杨将军参与就天津事件向中央政府发送联合电报一事。由于杨将军不认识上述两人，故复电拒绝。

杨将军于上月31日派遣一名副官前往南京，向冯督军祝贺其就任副总统之职。

约350名籍贯为安徽的叛乱分子已离开上海前往汉口，他们将归附于向海潜的领导下。该党派的最终意图尚不清楚。

在上月31日举行的市内前华捕会议上，决定于本月3日军警拟议重组之际举行庆祝活动。同时同地（新舞台剧院）将为在革命期间牺牲的成员举行追悼会。

据报，著名叛乱领袖黄兴将军于上月31日凌晨4时在其费伦路393号寓所逝世。他患肺病及胃病已有一段时间。现宣布，与其葬礼相关的预备仪式将于今晚8时举行。

（批：D/S）

您忠实的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监
